verdict.rationale: Elastic documents a one-line `curl -fsSL https://elastic.co/start-local | sh` quickstart that sets up Elasticsearch and Kibana in Docker 'for local development or testing'. That gives a disposable environment fully separate from production. A free 14-day serverless trial project offers a second, cloud-hosted way to stand up a separate test project. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or test mode with sample or cloned data (e.g. seeding from production snapshots), agent-specific guidance on isolating test runs from production clusters, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
